title: Standard Pistol
description: Modeled after the Taurus PT92 and Beretta 92FS, this standard-issue semi-automatic sidearm is ubiquitous across Los Santos law enforcement and street crews.

title: Combat Pistol
description: Based on the Heckler & Koch P2000, offering improved stopping power, higher magazine capacity, and crisp semi-automatic recoil control.

title: AP Pistol
description: An armor-piercing machine pistol inspired by the Colt SCAMP and OTs-33 Pernach, regarded as the premier drive-by sidearm due to its blistering automatic fire rate.

title: Heavy Revolver
description: A high-caliber six-shooter inspired by the Taurus Raging Bull, delivering devastating one-shot body damage at the expense of heavy cylinder cycle times.

title: Micro SMG
description: Based on the iconic Mini Uzi, this compact submachine gun can be fired from within vehicles during high-speed chases and urban shootouts.

title: SMG
description: The quintessential MP5 submachine gun with a collapsible stock, providing low muzzle climb and dependable intermediate-range automatic fire.

title: Combat PDW
description: Modeled after the SIG Sauer MPX, featuring an integrated suppressor shroud that muffles gunshots and prevents radar pings during stealth infiltration.

title: Pump Shotgun
description: A 12-gauge Mossberg 590 pump-action shotgun found in every police cruiser, delivering lethal buckshot spreads at close-quarters room-clearing distances.

title: Sawed-Off Shotgun
description: A modified double-barrel break-action shotgun with shortened barrels, compact enough to be drawn and fired from motorcycles and bicycles.

title: Assault Shotgun
description: Inspired by the UTAS UTS-15, this drum-fed fully-automatic combat shotgun dismantles vehicle armor and clears fortified corridors in seconds.

title: Carbine Rifle
description: Modeled after the ubiquitous Colt M4A1, the Carbine Rifle serves as the all-around benchmark for combat accuracy, handling, and tactical customization.

title: Assault Rifle
description: A rugged Kalashnikov AK-47 variant featuring stamping and wood furniture that delivers heavier per-bullet damage across medium combat ranges.

title: Special Carbine
description: Based on the Heckler & Koch G36C, combining a lightweight polymer composite frame with superior muzzle velocity and recoil stabilization.

title: Advanced Rifle
description: A bullpup assault rifle based on the IWI Tavor CTAR-21, delivering rapid cyclic fire with compact maneuverability in confined corridors.

title: Sniper Rifle
description: An AWM-style bolt-action precision marksman rifle equipped with high-magnification telescopic glass for long-range tactical target neutralization.

title: Heavy Sniper
description: A devastating .50 BMG anti-materiel rifle based on the Barrett M82, capable of piercing engine blocks and taking down tail rotors in a single trigger pull.

title: Marksman Rifle
description: A designated marksman rifle modeled after the M14 EBR, providing rapid semi-automatic follow-up shots through an illuminated sniper optic.

title: RPG (Rocket Launcher)
description: The classic RPG-7 shoulder-fired rocket launcher, launching high-explosive anti-tank warheads that annihilate grouped infantry and light armored vehicles.

title: Minigun
description: A multi-barrel Gatling rotary heavy machine gun based on the M134, firing thousands of rounds per minute capable of tearing armored convoys to shreds.

title: Sticky Bomb (C4)
description: Plastic explosive charges fitted with high-power adhesive backing and a remote radio frequency detonator, perfect for ambush traps and security van doors.

title: Combat Knife
description: A 7-inch carbon steel fixed-blade tactical knife with serrated spine, tailored for silent takedowns and close-quarters hand-to-hand combat.
